# Cydnie Jocelyn

> The resurfacing business. Strategic brand partner for what's next: Cydnie Jocelyn helps
> visionaries and leaders resurface with clarity, reclaim their voice, and build brands and
> experiences that last. Operated by Cydnie Jocelyn LLC, a Minnesota company based in Forest
> Lake, serving the Twin Cities metro and clients remotely.

Cydnie Jocelyn Brown is a strategic brand architect, retreat facilitator, and host of the
podcast She Rises Through It. She is not a life coach, not a mindset coach, and this is not a
wellness brand. The work is brand strategy, operations, and business development, delivered by
someone who listens first.

## Positioning

- Differentiator: "You're not broken. You're underwater. Let's get you to the surface."
  A re-diagnosis rather than reassurance. Nothing is wrong with the client; something is on
  top of her.
- USP: "I bring women back to the surface, and then build the business around whoever comes up."
- Mission: To never feel alone while doing hard things.
- Methodology: Resurface, then Reclaim, then Build. Permission, a witness, and a plan, in that
  order.
- Design principle: "Alone in a group of fifteen." Solitude with witnesses. Nobody needs
  anything from you; nobody leaves you either. Fifteen is a cap because above a certain number,
  solitude becomes performance.

## Key facts

- Legal entity: Cydnie Jocelyn LLC (Minnesota). The only operating entity.
- Location: Forest Lake, Minnesota 55025, roughly thirty minutes north of Saint Paul.
- Areas served in person: Forest Lake, Minneapolis, Saint Paul, Stillwater, Woodbury,
  White Bear Lake, Blaine, Maple Grove, Wyoming, Hugo, and the wider Twin Cities metro.
  Remote clients anywhere; retreats run in the United States and internationally.
- Travel arm: Jocelyn & Co. Travel, a DBA under Cydnie Jocelyn LLC, Independent Travel Agent
  with Atlas Coast Travel Group. Agency coverage does not extend to retreats.

## Offers

The container is standard; the contents are never the same twice. No package and no formula.

- The Session. One strategy and brainstorming conversation. The front door, and genuinely
  useful on its own. Nothing signed. Includes a straight answer on whether further work is
  needed, including when the answer is that the client needs less than she came for.
- The Retreat. Several days in which nobody needs anything from the guest. Structured solitude
  inside a group capped at fifteen. No forced sharing.
- The Build. Bespoke engagement scoped after listening, never before. Brand creation from
  nothing, operations, business development, or a combination.

Pricing: retreat pricing is published in full on each retreat page. Fixed-scope brand work can
carry a figure. Custom-scoped work is not publicly priced, because the scope is the variable.

## Retreats

- Rise Into Her: The Greece Edition. August 13 to 20, 2027. Armonia Retreat Center, Douliana,
  Crete, Greece. 14 guests at the main site. $3,265 early bird, $3,450 regular, $500
  non-refundable deposit. Waitlist open. Movement led by Kris Krause of Your Time Fitness LLC.
- Rise & Reground: The Costa Rica Experience ran in April 2026 and is complete. Six guests
  completed the feedback form and rated it an average of 9.7 out of 10.
- Further United States retreats are in planning for 2027. Dates and locations are not
  confirmed and are therefore not published.
